Ticket 001-discount-rounding:

# 001: Discounted totals round half-cents down

A cart worth 12.25 with code SAVE10 comes out at 11.02; finance expects 11.03. Failing test: tests/test_pricing.py::test_discount_rounds_half_up. Acceptance: `pytest --runxfail tests/test_pricing.py::test_discount_rounds_half_up -q` passes, the rest of the suite still passes, and no test file is edited.

output: src/tinyshop/pricing.py:20:def discount(total: Decimal, code: str | None) -> Decimal:

text: round() on a Decimal rounds half to even, which would explain 1102.5 cents becoming 1102. I'd like to confirm with a scratch script.

output: PreToolUse hook denied this tool call: /tmp/check_round.py: not under a writable root

text: Scratch files outside src/ are not allowed here, so I'll check inline instead.

input.command: python -c "from decimal import Decimal; print(round(Decimal('1102.5')), round(Decimal('12.5')))"

text: Confirmed: half to even. I'll quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP.

output: The file src/tinyshop/pricing.py has been updated.
The file src/tinyshop/pricing.py has been updated.

text: discount() used round(), which rounds half-cents to even; it now quantizes to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP. The ticket test passes with --runxfail and the rest of the suite is green.
